ai.prediction_writeup: Despite the Elo model calling this a toss-up and Paris FC's solid home results this season, Rennes' historical edge in this matchup is impossible to ignore. The visitors have won 4 of 6 all-time meetings and took the most recent encounter 2-1. While Rennes' 0–4 loss at Olympique Lyon was a setback, they had previously strung together three straight wins including victories over Olympique Marseille and Le Mans. With 53 previous belt reigns to their name, Rennes have the experience to reclaim the belt in a tight road contest.
